column1: # collector-manifest.tsv — what this directory is, for the four readers that
# partition cmd/collectors: the membership census, the standalone census, the
# isolation census and the publish sweep.
# THE FORMAT IS key<TAB>value, one pair per line, `#` comments and blank lines
# ignored. Neither the name of this file nor its key names are chosen here: both
# come from scripts/testdata/collector-port-contract.tsv, the ONE declaration
# those four readers share, so no two of them can look for different spellings of
# the same thing. A tab separator is what lets a build command carry spaces with
# no quoting rule for four readers in two languages to disagree about.
# CARRYING THIS FILE IS WHAT MAKES THIS DIRECTORY A PORT rather than a Go module.
# A directory carrying both this and a go.mod is a contradiction, not a merge, so
# this package has no go.mod and appears in none of go.work,
# scripts/lint-matrix.json or scripts/ci-go-cache-paths.sh.
# THE TWO COMMANDS RUN IN THIS DIRECTORY, in the PUBLISHED layout as well as
# here, with no workspace and no network beyond the committed lockfile. `npm ci`
# rather than `npm install`: it installs exactly what package-lock.json resolves
# and fails rather than updating it.
# ci_leg IS THE JOB KEY in .github/workflows/ci.yml, not the job's display name.
# The membership census fails when the two disagree.
